threat_event: Ransomware delivered by phishing encrypts endpoints and cloud workloads
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No endpoint detection and response; no phishing training; flat clinic networks
existing_controls: MFA; signature antivirus; automatic OS patching
treatment_plan: Deploy MSP-managed EDR with 24x7 alerting; phishing training and quarterly simulations; segment medical devices and servers

threat_event: Exfiltration of PHI during a ransomware attack (double extortion)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No egress monitoring; no data loss prevention
treatment_plan: Firewall egress filtering and alerting on large transfers; log review (AU-6)

threat_event: Business email compromise of a staff mailbox exposes PHI in email
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PHI routinely emailed; no training on phishing
treatment_plan: Training; enforce encryption for external PHI email; mailbox auditing

threat_event: Former employee accesses the EHR after termination
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Accounts disabled about 5 business days after termination
treatment_plan: Same-day disable in the identity provider triggered by HR ticket; monthly reconciliation

threat_event: Backups are deleted or encrypted with production so imaging and interface data cannot be recovered
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backup vault in same region and account; not immutable; never restore-tested
treatment_plan: Separate backup account with immutable retention and second region; quarterly restore tests; break-glass accounts

threat_event: Workforce member views patient records without a job need
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No audit log or access report review
treatment_plan: Monthly EHR access report review; HIPAA sanctions policy

threat_event: Attacker exploits the unsupported operating system on the X-ray modality workstation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Unsupported OS; shared login; on flat network
treatment_plan: Isolate on a device VLAN now; replace workstation with vendor-supported model

threat_event: Theft of an unencrypted desktop exposes cached PHI
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 58 desktops unencrypted
treatment_plan: Enable full-disk encryption on all desktops

threat_event: EHR vendor outage longer than the 4-hour RTO
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No downtime procedures; single SaaS dependency
treatment_plan: Paper downtime kits and procedures; confirm vendor RTO/RPO in contract

threat_event: Internet outage at Clinic B stops clinical work
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single ISP at Clinic B
treatment_plan: Cellular failover at Clinic B

threat_event: PHI disclosed by a fax or telehealth vendor with no BAA
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No BAA; no vendor security review
treatment_plan: Execute BAAs or replace vendors

threat_event: AI scribe vendor processes PHI without a BAA or uses it to train models
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot started before contract review
treatment_plan: Pause new enrollments until BAA executed with no-training terms (see P10)

threat_event: Unpatched firewall firmware exploited for remote access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Firmware not patched on a schedule
existing_controls: No management interface exposed to the internet
treatment_plan: Quarterly firmware updates by MSP; vulnerability scanning

threat_event: Cloud administrator account taken over through MFA fatigue or credential theft
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Three admins with standing access
existing_controls: Hardware security keys for all admins
treatment_plan: Accepted by Practice Administrator: residual risk Low

threat_event: PHI recovered from a hard drive that was not properly destroyed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Drives destroyed in-house without certificates
treatment_plan: Use certified destruction vendor with certificates

threat_event: Fax or email with PHI sent to the wrong recipient
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No verification step; no training
treatment_plan: Training; address verification prompt; cloud fax contact lists

threat_event: OCR enforcement action after a breach because no risk analysis was documented
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No risk analysis 2021-2026
treatment_plan: Annual risk analysis update; retain for 6 years

threat_event: Interface engine failure delays critical lab results
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single VM; no monitoring
treatment_plan: Interface queue monitoring and alerting

threat_event: Hurricane closes a clinic for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No contingency plan or alternate site
treatment_plan: Contingency plan with cross-clinic relocation and remote work

threat_event: Power outage corrupts studies stored on the modality workstation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No UPS on modality
existing_controls: Studies sent to archive after each exam
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low

threat_event: Billing staff export patient lists for personal gain
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Excess EHR report-writer rights
treatment_plan: Remove report-writer rights; review bulk exports monthly

threat_event: Compromise of the MSP remote management tool gives attackers access to all endpoints
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MSP tool has unrestricted access; no MSP security review
treatment_plan: Require MFA and IP restrictions on MSP tooling; annual MSP security review with SOC 2 or questionnaire

threat_event: Clearinghouse outage delays claims beyond cash reserves
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single clearinghouse
treatment_plan: Accepted: line of credit covers 30 days

threat_event: Unauthorized entry to Clinic B through untracked keys
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Keyed locks; 6 closet key holders; no log
treatment_plan: Install badge reader at Clinic B entrance and closet

threat_event: Staff do not report a suspected incident so breach clocks are missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident reporting channel or training
treatment_plan: Publish reporting channel; include in training

threat_event: Networked ECG cart used as a pivot into the clinic network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Medical devices on the user network
treatment_plan: Device VLAN (same work as R-007)

threat_event: Denial of service against the patient portal
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor-hosted; outside practice control
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low

threat_event: AI scribe inserts an error into a clinical note that leads to patient harm
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No output quality monitoring in pilot
regulatory_driver: N62-R07 (45 CFR 92.210 if used for decisions)
treatment_plan: Mandatory provider review attestation; monthly note sampling (see P10)

threat_event: Security documentation not retained for 6 years
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No retention rule for security records
treatment_plan: Retention schedule for security documentation

threat_event: Unauthorized person joins a telehealth visit
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Default meeting settings; no BAA
treatment_plan: Waiting rooms; vendor with BAA (R-011)

threat_event: Attacker uses default admin password on networked vital-sign monitors to alter settings or pivot
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manufacturer default admin passwords on 4 monitors (found in P07 testing)
treatment_plan: Change default passwords; add to device VLAN (R-007)
